title: status readers A: backlog counts, capture queue, decisions active, cells-derived status helpers
action: Port the first half of the status read spine into bee-core (read-only, zero subprocess): readBacklogCounts (backlog.mjs:543), captureQueue (capture.mjs:100), activeDecisions (decisions.mjs:810 — the active-decision projection incl. supersession and redaction semantics, READ path only, no writes), and the cells-derived status helpers from cells.mjs: archivedTotals, readyCells, scribingDebt, globalScribingDebt, tierMix, ceilingScarcityWarning. Every struct round-trips unknown fields (D3, serde flatten pattern). ORACLE DISCIPLINE — the bee-core-side pattern of record is crates/bee-core/tests/fsutil_oracle.rs (file-based node driver executing the REAL frozen mjs module over the same fixture, diffing results): each ported reader is diffed that way, over a host-real-shaped fixture (queen-bench --generate) plus edge fixtures (empty store, corrupt/truncated jsonl tail, unknown extra fields). ALL tests live in ONE integration target status_readers_a (verify uses cargo --test status_readers_a; a missing target exits 101 — the target name is load-bearing).

truths: cargo --test status_readers_a runs and reports at least 15 passed, output listing fixture names per reader
every ported reader's output equals the real mjs module's output on the same fixture (oracle-diffed), including the host-real fixture and the corrupt-tail fixture
unknown fields survive on every struct (no field loss)
no subprocess spawn inside any reader

trace.outcome: Ported the first half of the status read spine into bee-core: readBacklogCounts (fold-first PBI layer + legacy docs/backlog.md table, product_root-aware), captureQueue (pending-stub fold), activeDecisions (supersession/redaction exclusion, decision-propagation tag overlay, archive-union), and the cells.mjs status helpers archivedTotals/readyCells/scribingDebt/globalScribingDebt/tierMix/ceilingScarcityWarning — all zero-subprocess, all oracle-diffed against the real frozen mjs modules over a host-real queen-bench fixture plus edge fixtures (empty store, 7-shape corrupt jsonl tails, unknown-field round-trips). Oracle diffing caught and fixed two real divergences: fold_pbis's hand-rolled trim didn't strip a leading BOM the way JS's String.trim does (now reuses fsutil::read_jsonl), and tierMix's ceilingShare rendered 0.0 instead of JS's unified-number 0 (added a js_number JSON-shape helper).
